messages.content: Explain what a black hole is. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: A black hole is an area in space where gravity is so incredibly strong that nothing, not even light, can escape its pull. This extreme gravity usually forms when a massive star dies and collapses in on itself, squeezing a huge amount of matter into an unimaginably tiny space. Because no light can escape, these objects are invisible, but scientists can detect them by observing how their powerful pull affects nearby stars and gas.
